features.label: {s,z,n,f,r,x,w,l} vs {m,h,i,u,j,digits}: first-slot memory (orig 0 > 1 > ...) in original, current/next output in copy

signed token value read from the queue head (first 3 originals ramped in; copy: current output, input, next output). Raised by g>q>e>u, then y/w/0/b/n/t/2. Lowered by i/m/r/f/c/d/j/v and also p/a/k/o/s/1/3/l/z
signed axis {2,c,z,l}+/{u,i,m,r,e,g,s,x}-: average over held tokens, then output queue

Signed token axis (u>d,w,2>i,s,p,t vs l,e,a,y,3,z,1,x and weakly q,o,r,n,g,c,j,f,0) read from early memory slots (orig): the current input pushes the other way in the original phase; copy phase reads emitted, current and next tokens
signed axis k>r>y>h>d>a vs i,q,z,x,u,v: held in memory, then current/queued outputs
m-detector (weaker z,x,1): early original slots; copy: current/next/just-output token
signed axis {0>>g,r,i,2,p} vs {v,k,e,3,q,u}: memory of earlier inputs; copy: current/next output
o (also g,3,u; minus y,s,1,0,d) in early slots; copy: o near output
copy phase: current/next output raised by p,q,f,b (then s,u,1,3), lowered by i,c,w,e,n,2,r,x,y,l; fed-back p boosts
y/s/1 in first original slots (o erases); copy: y/s/1 output now or next
n held in memory (esp. first token); copy: outputting n, n queued next

copy phase: graded scale over the current output (most weight), the next memory slot (about half) and the slot after that (a little): c,d,f,0 >> a,e,w,q > o,u > b,n,y ~ 0 > j,r,v,x,z > k,s,t,3,i,m,l > 1,2,h,p,g; lowered further when the fed-back input is p or g
v in first slots: original phase lifts after 2 steps (0 input boosts); copy: v output/next
copy phase: signed token axis (h,1,x,f up; a,w,b,s down) on current output, then queue
3-axis (3>d>t>x up; n,a,1,j down) on queue head: orig(0..1) while reading, current/next output in copy

copy phase: signed token axis over the current output (weight ~1.0), next queued output (~0.5) and the one after (~0.1); up for b, j, e, z, h, g, u, 3, f, 0; down for x, w, t, k, q, a, d, l, o, n, r, 1, 2, y, p
signed {c,3,t,2,v,j}+ / {b,m,s,0,n,r,i}- axis over recent inputs, carried through <DEL> in short sequences; copy: queue axis plus copy input b/m/0/s raising it
original phase: recent inputs (lag 2-4) on axis {i,l,x,d,h} up vs {p,z,k,t,j} down
input phase: signed by first ~4 original tokens (a,w,s,t up; h,f,1,e down)
early tokens orig(0..3) in memory: j,t,b,z,g raise; l,x,w,d lower

original phase and <DEL>: signed sum of the stored tokens' values on one axis (p,1,3,2,g,l,h,x,m,t raise; d,0,c,w,e,f,a,u lower). Weight falls with slot: first token >> second > later ones, which count only once 2+ steps back. Strongest at <DEL>.
orig: recent {1,h,m,x,v,q} up, {r,k,o,p,j,g} down; copy: sign flips, queue ahead
signed token axis (z>>l,b,w>digits/q vs r,d,y,a,t,x) over last ~4 inputs; copy: queue 1-3 ahead
early original tokens (slots 0-3, decaying weight) {f,p,q,1,d} raise, {v,l,z,h,i} lower strongly, {w,e,j,t,y,r,k,g} lower mildly; active t>=2 through DEL
signed {e,b,g,h,3} vs {1,a,c,s,i,w} axis over last ~4 inputs; copy: queue 2-3 ahead
signed axis {j,1,m,a,k} up vs {l,x,g,i} down over last ~3 inputs; copy: spikes on input l/g/x
p/q (also f,u) in last ~3 inputs, strongest early; copy: p/q queued 1-3 ahead
copy phase: graded token axis on current output, then next 2 queued
copy phase: outputting/queued l>h>d>b raises, t/j/z/c lowers
input phase t>=2: first two tokens in {x,t,c,n,1,o,r,2} raise, {z,l,m,w,h,s,0} lower; b resets
n,v,i,j,u (+) vs y,m,r,t,e (-) in last ~4 inputs (v only once it is 1+ steps back), effect fading with position; copy: same score over the tokens still waiting in memory (up to ~6 ahead)
copy phase, weighted toward outputting t/j (and other favored letters)
signed axis {f,n,e,x,h,0,z,1}+ vs {v,i,w,b,p,m,d,k}-: last ~3 inputs (original), queue ahead (copy)
{u,w,d,0,c,f,e,b} in last ~4 inputs raise, {l,p,r,3,z,k,j,g} lower; copy: queue
early {a,y,q,l,k,...} inputs raise it; copy: S+ queued ahead raises, y/k input lowers

signed axis {g,0,2,y,i}+ vs {v,f,3,k}-: early recent inputs; copy: queue ahead
